paragraphs: Chapter 997
Episode 246. Mithra Desert Battle (7)
The Barmel Alliance deployed Jin and Luna as Team 1, and Eltiot, Hedo, Vanessa, Owl, Yona, Qwaul, and Valeria as Team 2 in the desert.
This division into teams was intentional, as Shimat predicted, to understand phenomena related to the void space.
However, Jin thought that Eltiot, Qwaul, and Valeria might have difficulty properly investigating the desert.

Even if Team 1 could buy time, Team 2 would not be able to completely avoid the enemy's detection and infiltrate, since the enemy had dispatched reconnaissance ships in the Mithra Desert, and the desert was still filled with hostile energy waves, rendering Owl's ability useless.
However, since Qwaul personally expressed hope, they had returned to the battlefield, albeit recklessly.

"I hope we can find some solid leads with Dr. Qwaul's intuition this time. If your four Demon King brothers join us, it would be perfect," Luna said. She and Jin were advancing through the desert, pushing back the hostile energy waves.

Space jump was unusable due to the enemy's energy waves. If they couldn't break the enemy's space-jump obstruction technology, the Barmel Alliance would have to continue searching the desert in this way.
"Expectations lead to bigger disappointments, so if we don't find any clues today, we'll approach it slowly in the future."
"Right, since the enemy controls the desert, it's a dangerous task."

"I'm also annoyed by the demons summoned by Kinzelo. Even if the Laprarosa liberation device is completed, if we have to use it inside the desert, they will obstruct us till the end... We can't attack, so we won't have any way to stop them."
"But somehow, I feel good about it. After all, thanks to the appearance of those demons, the fact that your brothers' energy manifested is true, so let's think positively for now."
Jin nodded, and Luna cautiously observed his mood.
‘The youngest, he seems troubled, probably because of failing to summon the black light three times.’
Just before entering the desert from Tikan, once near the desert while moving, and once after entering the desert.
Before starting this operation, Jin attempted to summon the black light a total of three times.
But he failed every single time. Unlike usual, the black portal leading to Laprarosa did not open.
That troubled Jin. Up to now, he had never failed to summon, as long as it wasn't a 'dead world.'
Soon, Jin fixed his expression and smiled at Luna.
"Understood, sister. By the way, you've come to sound a bit like Sir Eltiot."
"Crack!"
"Haha."
All of a sudden, a dark burst of energy began to surge in the center of the desert just after Luna had imitated Eltiot.
The two stopped talking for a few seconds as they looked at the faintly glowing, massive energy hidden by the enemy's brain waves in the distance.
"Little brother! Isn't that... the energy of your brothers!?"
Bellize and Linpa. Just before the end of the first battle, the energy Jin felt was definitely theirs.
'This is, Ban's brother's...!'
However, what was now tearing through the center of the desert was clearly the energy of the god Ban. Jin felt his heart pounding as he took out his red jade.
[Meow!]
Shuri started running, carrying the two across the desert. It took quite a while to get close, as the distance was very far, but Ban's unique energy grew thicker as they neared.
'Could Ranke's summoning have created a variable that summoned my brothers from Laprarosa!?'
The energy of Ban seemed weak for a complete summoning. That meant there could be some problems in Laprarosa.
While Shuri was running, Jin felt like dry kindling burning up inside.
Luna sensed Jin's feelings and worried about her brother, but at the same time, she was relieved that there seemed to be no manifestation of Changseong's unique evil energy.
[Myaaaaa!]
Shuri's mighty roar echoed through the explosive sound of energy. Shuri, realizing the situation, was calling the Wangjang tribe in her way.
Jin also began to amplify his energy, emitting his brain waves.
If the Wangjang brothers were summoned to the desert somehow, they would recognize his energy.
Bellize and Linpa's response came three minutes later. The two had just finished video communication with Shimat and were about to leave the desert.
"Jin, brother...!?"
"Oh! I was unsure, but it was really Jin's brothers' energy, wasn't it!? Jin's brothers, right!?"
"Linpa brothers, Bellize brothers!"
Bellize and Linpa rushed over and hugged Shuri.
Jin knew at a glance. The Towang brothers had not undergone an incomplete summoning like the dark summoning but had undoubtedly completely left Laprarosa.
"Brothers, what happened!? Are you hurt anywhere?"

"Hurt! As soon as we came out, we smashed those so-called elites created by that Kinjelo or whatever. There were dozens of warships, but most of them melted away due to Ban's brother's energy. We only directly dealt with two."
"Master?"
"Those with the red heart of light. They're not masters?"
"Ah, those guys are not masters but an ancient race called Jukmyeongjok."
"What, ancient Jukmyeongjok!?"

"First, please tell me how the brothers managed to get out. Since yesterday, I've been fighting against the Jukmyeongjok here, and I noticed the aura of Linpa's brothers and Bellize's brothers. I came back to the desert to check the phenomenon, but I never thought I would run into the brothers like this..."
Jin briefly explained the current situation and the fact that the dark summoning had failed. It was not a situation where he could explain in detail, as the Jukmyeongjok would surely attack soon.

"Ah, I see! The dark summoning failed because a crack formed in Lafrarosa. Suddenly, the void near the battle of gods split open, and the red aura, magic, aura, and the brothers' energy began to pour in like crazy."
As Bellize said, the crack in Lafrarosa happened at the very moment the demons were summoned.
From then on, the Jukmyeongjok began to fend off the energy pouring through the crack, but they couldn't exert their full strength as 'space collapse' made all of Lafrarosa unstable.
The effect of the desert pouring into the crack itself wasn't a problem. What troubled the Jukmyeongjok was the gravity of Lafrarosa.
Due to a dimensional error, Lafrarosa seemed to compress and crush the Jukmyeongjok. Most warriors couldn't withstand the terrible sensation and fainted.
Bellize explained this, looking at Jin.

"......So, the brothers of Tushin and Tuking spread a shield to protect the others. Then another crack appeared near us, but it seemed like it would close soon. But the Tushin brothers instinctively knew that the crack was connected to this world."
"So...... we came out through that crack."
"Right. But Linpa's brothers and I couldn't open the crack further. So the Tushin brothers used their power directly. The effect melted all the ships of the masters, no, the Jukmyeongjok."
"So then, the situation for the brothers left in Lafrarosa is not very good?"

"I can't say it's completely safe. But there were no deaths until we left. The brothers of Ban are protecting them directly, so don't worry too much. Now we just need to bring the remaining brothers to this world."
"Yes, Tushin...... brothers...... are strong. You know......?"
Ban is personally protecting the brothers.
That reassured Jin in an instant. If it was Ban, it seemed that he could protect the brothers in any abnormal phenomenon.
The task became even clearer. Jin calmed his rising emotions and looked back at the situation.

'The crack in Lafrarosa is surely related to the demons and the battle. If Dr. Kwa-ul is right, the channel formed when the demons were summoned, and that channel has widened due to the effects of the battle.'
The main cannon of the aerial fortress.
There was no doubt that the rift in Lafrarosa had expanded when that tremendous lightning mass repeatedly struck the desert.

'Suddenly, a gigantic power akin to the main cannon of an aerial fortress was poured into the desert, and there's a high likelihood that some kind of rebound reaction occurred between dimensions as the demon tribe absorbed that power. In that case, what can be expected right now is...'
A situation in which the aerial fortresses of the Jeokmyeok tribe drop their main cannons, and the demonic trio absorbs them.
At that moment of thought, a giant red curtain unfolded above the group's heads. The Jeokmyeok tribe had made a spatial leap towards the desert, leading the aerial fortress.
Naturally, it was a first.
The appearance of the Jeokmyeok aerial fortress emerging slowly from the bright red dimensional gate felt welcoming.
[Kahaha! The time for nutrient intake has come! Jin Run Kandel, and Shimat! Do you three enjoy this?]
[If we keep getting stronger like this, we won't be able to handle it, will we? Hehe, well, it's none of my business.]

Even the lucky demonic trio revealed themselves again. Sribiwa and Karmashu were giggling at the thought of absorbing power in the battle to begin anew. Only Masalroon of sorrow had his usual gloomy face.
[Masalroon welcomes you. You will become the food of sorrow... no, no, that creature...!]
[Jeok Ok Myo... Isn't that the Jeok Ok Myo of the witch Shuri? Jin Run Kandel, have you become Shuri's master now?]
[Meow?]
Masalroon alternated between looking at Shuri and Jin before shedding thick tears.

[Ah, indeed Shuri! Then Masalroon will not harm Jin Run Kandel. Shuri, a life that fits more than anything with sorrow... Masalroon has admired that lovely Jeok Ok Myo for a long time. Oh, Shuri... please let Masalroon touch you once.]
[Meow, hiss!]
[Ah, Masalroon is starting again. That Jeok Ok Myo hates you.]
[Handle it yourself, Masalroon. But you'll have to explain it to Rankahan.]
Jin, Luna, and the Myeongwang tribe shrugged their shoulders, watching the demonic trio chatter among themselves as if they were rehearsing a play.
"Lady Luna, please escape immediately and inform Dr. Kwaoul of this situation. We brothers will take care of things here."
"Ah! I just realized I haven't properly greeted my brother's brothers yet. Nice to meet you, Luna Run Kandel. I've heard a lot about you from Jin."
"I'm... Linpa. Let's talk... more, Luna... after this is over."
Belrize and Linpa raised the great swords on their backs, positioning themselves to Jin's left and right. Luna could leave without any worries to find Team 2.
